prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young man is captured mid-movement on an outdoor basketball court, performing a dynamic breakdance pose. He wears a bold, geometric-patterned black and white jacket and light-wash jeans, his body angled toward the camera with one arm supporting his weight and his head tilted back, exuding confidence and energy. The background features a wire fence, a basketball hoop with the word "ARENA" above it, and a row of residential buildings and leafless trees under a dramatic, overcast sky. The image is shot in black and white, lending a moody, cinematic quality with high contrast and soft, diffused lighting. The composition is low and wide, with the subject in the foreground and the urban environment receding into the distance, creating a sense of depth and movement. The overall style is reminiscent of street photography or an urban dance film, emphasizing raw emotion and the gritty beauty of the cityscape.
